columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of the key indicator calendar period for which the report was submitted.

columns.name: NUM_INACTIVE_VENDORS
columns.description: Number of suppliers with a value in the Inactive On field that is on or before the current date.

columns.name: NUM_ONE_TIME_VENDORS
columns.description: Number of new suppliers designated as one-time suppliers.

columns.name: NUM_1099_VENDORS
columns.description: Number of new suppliers who are 1099 type suppliers. A 1099 supplier is one who is defined as Federal Reportable.

columns.name: NUM_VENDORS_HELD
columns.description: Number of new supplier sites that have supplier site holds.In the Supplier Sites window, you can hold all payments or hold unvalidated invoices for a supplier site.

columns.name: NUM_VENDORS_UPDATED
columns.description: Number of pre-existing suppliers with added or changed supplier information.
